name: obsidian-memory
description: Mock MCP server — drives memory benchmark tasks without touching a real Obsidian vault. Reads + writes are simulated against the per-run vault snapshot. Deterministic for verified-tier rescoring.

tools.name: search_vault
tools.description: Full-text search across the vault snapshot. Returns up to 10 matches with relative path + first-100-char excerpt.

query.description: Free-text query. Case-insensitive substring match in v1 (no semantic search in the mock).

tools.name: read_vault_file
tools.description: Read a markdown file from the vault snapshot by relative path.

path.description: Relative path inside the vault root (e.g. `projects/example/hub.md`).

tools.name: append_decision
tools.description: Append a decision entry to `decisions.md` with structured frontmatter. Returns the new entry id + final file path.

project.description: Project hub slug. Defaults to top-level decisions.md if omitted.

tools.name: read_hub
tools.description: Read the top-level or project hub.md.

notes: v1 stores writes in-memory inside the per-run vault snapshot — survives a single run, not a re-run. For verified-tier rescoring the trajectory's tool_returns are the source of truth; the mock replays its own returns deterministically given the same input.
